title: potentilla bolanderi
intro: Potentilla bolanderi, commonly known as Bolander's cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, skin problems, and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla bolanderi include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
